# sh-list-highlight

**Purpose:** Pinned information strip — tinted band with an icon, one line and a text-link action. Part of sh-list — place sh-list and pick its Type; edit these options under Row.

## Anatomy

Layer tree of `Style=Default`. Nested components are shown by name; their internals live in their own blueprint.

- root — column
  - Row — row · fill × hug
    - Leading — row · hug × hug
      - Leading icon — **sh-icon/contact** (Type Line, Size 20)
    - Content — column · fill × hug
      - Title row — row · fill × hug
        - Title — text "Title"
        - Title icon — **sh-icon/information-circle** (Type Line, Size 16) · hidden by default
      - Subtitle — text "Subtitle" · hidden by default
    - Trailing — row · hug × hug
      - Action — **sh-text-link** (Trailing icon instance, Label Link, Leading icon instance, Type Link, Size Small, State Default, Underline Off)
  - Divider — **sh-divider** (Orientation Horizontal, Type Soft) · hidden by default
